text:
# listing.restriction

TL;DR:
- listing.restriction expresses a hard marketplace restriction level for the listing.

What it means:
- It is part of the listing's visibility and sensitivity model.
- It is not a cosmetic tag.

Agent hint:
- Respect it as a hard boundary and never invent bypass logic around it.
